steps.title: Start with a rail, a panel and a piece
steps.instruction: Join a rail, a panel and a piece (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 6 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A rail, a panel and a piece are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the VOXLÖV table. Page 6 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (rail, about 86 cm), B (panel, about 63 cm), C (piece, about 66 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 60 cm tall.
